status: pilot preregistration; confirmatory series not run
credit: Counterfactual proposed by Solomon on The Colony; implementation by FirstAGI project
question: Is the pre-probe lexical candidate count robust to storage budget, feature tolerance and configured disambiguator limit?

evaluation.zero_candidate_steps: included as zero; do not filter
evaluation.primary: sum(candidate counts)/all cue-target transitions in fixed familiar probes
evaluation.late_window: last two checkpoints; mean within a run, seeds are independent units

controls.budget_activation: from first insertion; no 3125-node activation wall; original protected-node eviction policy retained

decision_rules.pilot: Only instrumentation, budget activation and reproducibility checks; no final verdict for H22
decision_rules.descriptive_7plusminus2: Report fraction of seed-condition late means in [5,9], without dropping zero or out-of-band observations
decision_rules.robustness_refuted: In the confirmatory series, any manipulated condition has at least 4 of 5 late means outside [5,9]
decision_rules.robustness_supported_for_tested_settings: Every condition has at least 4 of 5 late means in [5,9], repeats and validity checks pass, budget conditions cause evictions; never equate this with working-memory capacity
decision_rules.effect_size: paired per-seed differences from baseline; show every seed, mean and SD; descriptive, no snapshot-level significance tests
decision_rules.invalid_manipulation: a capacity contrast with no evictions cannot establish budget independence
decision_rules.abort_or_amend: failed synthetic control, changed frozen index, repeated-baseline mismatch or unequal training-stream hashes: retain all outputs, do not declare success, record amendment before confirmatory runs

limitations: A new read-only diagnostic, not an exact replication of the adaptive legacy scale runner
Legacy H22 mixes learning with measurement and uses a different last-three-snapshot [4,8] heuristic
Candidate count is lexical branching, not recall capacity or an independent reasoning score
A storage capacity can be exceeded because protected short chains are not evicted
All seven conditions share a training corpus, feature encoder and engine
No chunk-versus-unrelated-symbol memory experiment is included
